name: Doornik-628B
description: Doornik-628B was the second planet in the Doornik-628 system, which was located in the Farlax sector, a part of the Negs portion of the Core Worlds. The planet orbited the star Doornik-628 and was itself circled by a single moon. Doornik-628B, like its neighbor Doornik-628C, featured acidic clouds.
